name: Pelagos Data Centre
notes: Major data centre planned near the Port of Gibraltar on a 20,000 sq m site; announced as five phases delivering up to 250 MW by 2033, first stage scheduled for late 2027, privately funded and backed by the Government of Gibraltar.

name: Continent 8 Gibraltar Datacentre
notes: Operational secure hosting facility 500 m inside the Rock of Gibraltar at the historic COMCEN/Admiralty Tunnel site; government source says it hosts gaming companies and the Government of Gibraltar under a five-year hosting contract running June 2022 to June 2027.

name: Rockolo Mount Pleasant
notes: Gibtelecom's Rockolo business operates the Mount Pleasant data centre; DCD reported Mount Pleasant and the then-new World Trade Center site together provided about 17,200 sq ft of data centre space, with Mount Pleasant holding a CEEDA Silver certificate.

name: Rockolo World Trade Center
notes: Rockolo opened a second Gibraltar facility in the World Trade Center in February 2017; DCD described it as part of Gibtelecom's dedicated data centre services subsidiary and noted the WTC location for international business partnerships.

name: GIBFIBRE Data Centre
notes: Purpose-built data centre at New Harbours opened in July 2024; company materials describe Tier 3, ISO 27001 and cleanroom certifications, while DCD reports 30 racks across two contained hot aisles with 2.5 kW or 5 kW rack options.

name: Sapphire Europort
notes: Operational colocation/data centre service at Eurotowers, 3 Europort Road / Suite 942 Europort; Data Center Map describes it as a chilled water-cooled co-location facility with up to 4 kW power per rack, and secondary Gibraltar coverage describes Sapphire as a data centre services provider at Europort.
